summary: Kforce Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 stock trading plan to repurchase its own common stock. The plan, authorized by the board, runs from June 16, 2026 to July 29, 2026 and will be executed through an independent broker with price, market, volume, and timing constraints. No specific dollar amount, share target, or price per share was disclosed. The filing is a capital return event via share repurchase. Watch for actual repurchase volumes and any program expansions.
